name: Sheber
title: Descendant of Caleb
summary: Sheber was a son of Caleb and his concubine Maacah, mentioned in the book of Chronicles. He belonged to the tribe of Judah and was part of a prominent lineage in Israel. His name appears in the genealogies that document the tribal history of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Sheber is listed as one of the sons of Caleb by his concubine Maacah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Family and Descendants
keyEvents.description: Sheber is part of a broader family tree showing Caleb's many descendants, who became important in the history of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Faithfulness and Inheritance
keyEvents.description: Caleb's faithfulness to God resulted in him receiving land and a large family, including Sheber, as part of God's promise to him.

keyEvents.title: Genealogies of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles document the descendants of the tribe of Judah, with Sheber included as part of Caleb's line.
